notesStmt.note: Whitman likely wrote the draft on or shortly before March 17, 1888, the date indicated in the note at the bottom.

This manuscript contains a draft of the poem "Continuities," which was first published in the 20 March 1888 issue of the New York Herald. Later in the same year it appeared in November Boughs, and it was subsequently included in the "Sands at Seventy" annex to Leaves of Grass.
